# Colour maps resolved at runtime

Read from:
- `src/tenant/common/data/staticLists.js`
- `src/tenant/bayut/data/packages.js`
- `src/tenant/bayut/data/staticLists.js`

None of these is a theme token. Each is a lookup the product performs against a
string the API supplies, which is why reading `foundations.md` alone leaves them
looking like gaps.

## Profile completion ring

`tenantData.getClassificationColor(user.profile_completion.classification)`.
The classification word comes from the API; the mapping does not.

| classification | colour |
|---|---|
| `high` | `theme['success-color']` |
| `low` | `theme['error-color']` |
| `medium` | `theme['warning-color']` |

## Package tiers

`tenantData.packages[tenantData.slugToType[slug]]`. Drives the plan badge in
Credits Balance.

| tier | icon | packageColor | textColor |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bronze` | `IconPkgBronze` | `#FFF3E8` | `#B85E39` |
| `silver` | `IconPkgSilver` | `tenantTheme.gray600` | `#9C9C9C` |
| `gold` | `IconPkgGold` | `#FBEFD9` | `#F2910A` |
| `platinum` | `IconPkgPlatinum` | `#E7F3FB` | `#5CB2F8` |
| `platinum-plus` | `IconPkgPlatinumPlus` | `#FFD1002B` | `#DFBC21` |
| `starter` | `IconPkgStarter` | `#44C1812B` | `#32BF77` |
| `starter-pro` | `IconPkgStarterPro` | `#A97BEA2B` | `#A97BEA` |
| `titanium` | `IconPkgTitanium` | `#F7E7FF` | `#DFBC21` |

## Platform brand colour

`platformList[].brandColor` = `tenantTheme['primary-color']`

This is the accent behind the chart line, the credit meter and the tab ink bar.
For **bayut** it is not API-supplied — it resolves to the primary colour.
(zameen hardcodes its own per platform; bayut does not.)
